tree_checklist: Tree, in order: Angel. Lights. Mistletoe. Ornaments. Nativity. Doves. Box word: first things first. Tree team: A.P. and R.F.

rooms.name: Entrance Hall
rooms.info: The way in. Coat pegs, the staff noticeboard, the gift-wrap table, and the staff lockers, which stay shut until Round 2.

rooms.name: Dining Table
rooms.info: The long table where the party sat, Gideon's chair, and the mulled wine pot.

rooms.name: The Tree
rooms.info: The Christmas tree at the end of the table, with the Secret Santa gifts underneath.

rooms.name: The Bar
rooms.info: The lit bar counter. By day, Doris sells chocolates here: gold-foil marzipan truffles and silver-foil nut-free ones.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.info: Armchairs, and Gideon's cabinet with his brass safe and the first aid kit.

rooms.name: The Glass Wall
rooms.info: A wall of glass onto the patio, with two doors. Roz painted a snow scene on it tonight.

rooms.name: The Patio
rooms.info: Outside, along the glass wall. The decorations chest, with the ornament box inside.

rooms.name: Patio Lounge
rooms.info: Chairs and tables at the far end of the patio. The only phone signal in the building.
